prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
Two parallel vertical bars with soft rounded ends, flat dark fill,
uniform width — standard pause glyph.
formatted_prompt: Flat modern app icon centered on an off-white (#E7E3D5) canvas with generous padding, crisp vector geometry, no textures or gradients. Two parallel vertical rectangles with fully rounded pill-shaped ends, uniform width, equal spacing between them, rendered in deep near-black (#0B0F14) flat fill. The pause glyph is perfectly symmetrical, bold silhouette reduced to its essential two-bar form, sharp clean edges readable at 16px. Centered composition, no background elements, no shadow, no decoration. Muted off-white ground, stark dark bars, high contrast, 2026-era UI icon register.
